1 · Intro

When to use it.

Use this for a termination for behavior or a policy violation.

Before you start, talk to your PCB consultant and department leadership. Settle two things: when access is revoked, and how the rehire field is marked.

HCM Academy job aid · Offboarding

Involuntary termination (misconduct)

Use when: An employee is terminated for misconduct. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Talk to your PCB consultant and department leadership first.
  2. Quick Actions > Terminate Employment (or search the employee's name).
  3. Notification date and termination date: usually today.
  4. Action: Involuntary termination. Reason: Misconduct.
  5. Click Continue.
  6. Revoke access: immediately or after termination, per your PCB consultant. It depends on the offense.
  7. Rehire field: No or Not specified, per your PCB consultant and leadership.
  8. Last working day: today, or leave blank.
  9. Click Submit.

Watch-outs

  • Don't start the transaction until access timing and the rehire field are settled.
  • Open item: confirm the exact name of the rehire eligibility field.
